description: This file defines an internal interface and a sealed class implementing that interface, related to filtering messages for repartitioning in Orleans Runtime. The class utilizes a checker to determine migratability of grains involved in messages and applies logic to decide whether a message is acceptable for repartitioning purposes.

classes.name: IRepartitionerMessageFilter
classes.description: An internal interface defining a method to determine if a message is acceptable for repartitioning based on migratability checks.

classes.name: RepartitionerMessageFilter
classes.description: A sealed class implementing message filtering logic for repartitioning, utilizing a migrability checker to decide acceptability.

methods.name: IsAcceptable
methods.description: Determines if a message is acceptable for repartitioning, based on whether the sender or target grains are migratable and not the same grain.
